title: Timed traffic-light sequence
goal: A reviewer can trace the green, amber, and red timer sequence and its reset after the red interval.

rubric.must: A TON block labelled GreenTimer visibly shows a 30000 preset and drives the green phase.
GreenTimer.Q visibly enables AmberTimer and AmberTimer.Q visibly enables RedTimer.
GreenLamp, AmberLamp, and RedLamp appear on distinct rungs associated with their named timer contacts.
The AmberTimer TON block visibly shows a 4000 preset.
The RedTimer TON block visibly shows a 30000 preset.
A RedTimer.Q contact visibly operates reset coils for all three named timers.

ideal.notes: Independently hand-composed reference after visual-eval/exemplars/ladder/ideal.svg (sha256 72319743d0eb). Vision-reviewed rendered SVG against source and exemplar, including labels, connections and symbol placement. Measured spacious rung bands and consistent AB contact, coil and reset-bracket symbols. All rungs and branch membership preserved. PROVISIONAL: each TON is disabled by its own Q contact, so it resets on completion; the source does not implement the promised stable 30 s / 4 s / 30 s cycle.
